en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a tree-lined street with residential and storefront buildings featuring classic European architecture. Visible details include balconies, a sign reading 'Spielwaren' (which means 'toys' in German), 'Haus Downhof', an old-style car, and a horse-drawn cart. There is also a church or religious building with a pointed spire in the background. The text 'BAD PYRMONT' is stamped in purple on the lower left of the front. The reverse side of the postcard has handwritten messages, museum stamps ('MUSEUM IM SCHLOSS BAD PYRMONT'), and other numbers and handwritten text.
